6.1 Help System – Overview

The ABpE Portal has an integrated help system that provides context-sensitive help texts. The help can be either global (for the entire portal) or module-specific.

6.2 Help Modal Component

The help is displayed in a modal dialog. The component is defined in help_modal.html and is included in base.html.

<div class="help-modal" id="helpModal" onclick="closeHelpOnOutside(event)">
    <div class="help-content">
        <div class="help-header">
            <h5><i class="bi bi-question-circle"></i> 
                <span data-i18n="help_title">Help</span></h5>
            <button class="help-close" onclick="toggleHelp()">×</button>
        </div>
        <div id="helpContent">
            <!-- Dynamically populated from help.json -->
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

6.3 Help Functions (JavaScript)

The function toggleHelp() opens and closes the help modal and loads the corresponding help texts:

async function toggleHelp(moduleId = null) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('helpModal');
    const content = document.getElementById('helpContent');
    
    if (modal.classList.contains('show')) {
        modal.classList.remove('show');
        return;
    }
    
    // Load help content based on moduleId
    const lang = currentLang;
    const helpKey = moduleId ? `${moduleId}_help` : 'help';
    const response = await fetch(`/static/abpe_ui/i18n/${lang}/${helpKey}.json`);
    const helpData = await response.json();
    
    content.innerHTML = renderHelpSections(helpData.help_sections);
    modal.classList.add('show');
}

6.4 Help Files (JSON)

The help texts are stored in JSON files. The global help is located in help.json, module-specific help in {module}_help.json.

// help.json (global)
{
    "help_title": "Help & Tips",
    "help_sections": [
        {
            "title": "Navigation",
            "items": [
                "Sidebar icons become visible on hover",
                "Dashboard statistics can be expanded/collapsed"
            ]
        },
        {
            "title": "Keyboard Shortcuts",
            "items": [
                "? - Open help",
                "/ - Focus search field",
                "S - Expand/collapse statistics"
            ]
        }
    ]
}

6.5 Calling Help per Module

Each module can provide its own help by placing a {module}_help.json file in the i18n directory. The module-specific help is called with:

<button onclick="toggleHelp('dashboard')">Dashboard Help</button>

6.6 Keyboard Shortcuts

The help system is closely linked to the global keyboard shortcuts:

?
KeyFunctionArea
Open helpGlobal
/ Focus search field Global
S Expand/collapse statistics Dashboard
Ctrl + S Save CV Editor
Ctrl + E Export CV Editor

The keyboard shortcuts are handled in core-init.js with a global event listener.
